page.overview:
Who is Ulric Kerensky?

Ulric Kerensky was ilKhan of the Clans and Khan of Clan Wolf, steering invasion politics and the bid that led to the Battle of Tukayyid's truce.

Also known as: Ulric Kerensky ilKhan.
